response:
I am so sorry you have been dealing with bullying for so long. It is completely understandable that hearing those hurtful things repeatedly has made you start to believe them, but please know that their words do not define your worth. People who bully often do so out of their own insecurities, and their cruelty is a reflection of them, not you. You deserve to feel comfortable and confident in your own skin, and learning to separate your true value from their negativity takes time and support.

It is incredibly frustrating when you ask for help, like seeing a therapist, and your parents don't recognize how much you are struggling. Since your parents are hesitant right now, consider reaching out to a school counselor, a trusted teacher, or a doctor. They can offer you a safe space to talk about these feelings and might even be able to help explain to your parents why professional support is so important for your well-being. Please don't give up on advocating for yourself.
